name: nginx-backend
description: Nginx web server backend with testing framework

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: find src -name '*.test.c' -o -name '*_test.c' | xargs gcc -o /tmp/test_runner && /tmp/test_runner || echo 'No unit tests found'
scripts.test:integration: find . -name '*.test.c' -o -name '*_test.c' | xargs gcc -o /tmp/integration_test && /tmp/integration_test || echo 'No integration tests found'
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test && gcov src/*.c || echo 'Coverage not available'
scripts.test:nginx: make && make test || echo 'Nginx tests not configured'
scripts.lint: echo 'Backend linting skipped - platform specific tools not available'
